name: Poduri V Haricharan
headline: Senior React Developer · Product Engineer
summary: Full-stack product engineer with 5+ years building scalable, high-performance web applications using React.js, TypeScript, Hooks, and Context API, backed by Java/Spring Boot RESTful services and PostgreSQL. Proven record owning features end-to-end — from technical design through delivery — partnering with UX, product, and backend engineers in agile sprints. Drives code quality through rigorous code reviews and an 80% test-coverage bar (Vitest, Web Test Runner). Actively leverages AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, testing, and review cycles. Strong in monorepo build optimization, CI/CD automation, and translating complex domain constraints (regulated banking workflows on Temenos T24) into simplified, secure user experiences.

bullets.text: Engineered modular, scalable UI components in React.js, TypeScript, Hooks, and Context API — with deliberate attention to state management, component architecture, and web performance optimization — across a Temenos T24 banking application, reducing code duplication and improving long-term maintainability.

Owned end-to-end delivery of feature modules from design through ship and post-release maintenance, partnering with UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers across agile sprints to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
Optimized monorepo build performance using Webpack and Lerna, reducing build times by approximately 60% and accelerating developer feedback loops.

Designed and consumed RESTful APIs via Swagger/OpenAPI contracts backed by PostgreSQL schemas, collaborating with backend engineers on data modeling, query performance, and Spring Boot microservice implementation.
Established a two-runner unit test architecture (Vitest plus Web Test Runner) for services, state, and Lit web components, aligned with the 80% line/method coverage quality bar.
Authored unit and integration tests across multiple feature packages and built shared test helpers, lifting coverage and cutting duplicate setup team-wide.
Designed Jenkins gating logic and Bitbucket PR build automation, enabling per-branch test/coverage triggers and clean skips on branches without test infrastructure.
Presented integration framework and CI/CD pipeline architectures at internal design reviews, driving alignment across frontend, backend, and DevOps stakeholders.
Mentored junior engineers and conducted code reviews, raising team-wide code quality and accelerating onboarding.
Automated CI/CD on Docker, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, cutting release time by 25% and eliminating manual deployment steps.
Implemented token-based JWT authentication, integrated in-UI Git operations for GitLab/Bitbucket workflows, and leveraged AI tooling (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate refactoring and reviews.
Built interactive UI components with Kony Visualizer and JavaScript, and developed REST API integrations on Kony Fabric for core banking services.
Gained hands-on knowledge of T24 banking systems and end-to-end financial workflows, enabling domain-driven frontend development.
Supported Spring Boot microservices development and validation, contributing to API design and service testing.
